description: How much an athlete has done, week by week: hours and distance by sport, sessions done of asked — the athlete page's hours-per-week bars and the week sheet's rows. Default the last 12 weeks ending with the current (partial) one; week_start picks a single Monday-to-Sunday week. Load (TSS) says how hard; this says how much. Draws a page in the chat — "Your week" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

week_start.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a Monday: just that week.

name: get_training_volume
